attributes.input.value: GOVERN 1.3 (action GV-1.3-002) in the NIST GAI Profile recommends establishing minimum performance/assurance thresholds before deployment approval. Which specific purpose-built NIST testing environment does MEASURE 2.3 (action MS-2.3-004) recommend using to empirically evaluate GAI trustworthy characteristics?
attributes.output.value:
GOVERN 1.3 (action GV-1.3-002) in the NIST GAI Profile recommends establishing minimum performance/assurance thresholds before deployment approval. MEASURE 2.3 (action MS-2.3-004) recommends utilizing a purpose-built testing environment such as NIST Dioptra to empirically evaluate GAI trustworthy characteristics.

The specific recommendation from MEASURE 2.3 is for the use of NIST Dioptra, which is described in action MS-2.3-004.
